_note: Keys starting with _ are ignored. Geometry from 3pi-plus-32u4-oled-robot-dimensions.pdf: wheel diameter 32.0 mm; track = 96.0 mm outer width - 6.8 mm tyre width.
_calibration: white_dn*/black_dn* are mean raw readings at 0%/100% blackness over trials 1-6 (python tests/calibrate_sensors.py telemetry.csv). Normalised = clamp((raw - white) / (black - white), 0, 1). line_threshold and line_follow_gain act on normalised values.
